content:
elaine: Starting rollout plan for saturn-13b-v1 into the model catalog. Change window tonight 03:00-04:00 UTC. Canary sequence: 5% (15m) -> 25% (30m) -> 100% if no regressions. Fallback ordering set, want quick ack from SRE/ops. :eyes:
josh: Ack from eng-releases. Are we pinning any variants for enterprise customers during canary?
maya: Not pinning in general. For enterprise we will keep their current pin intact (customer pins override). For default routing: fallback ladder is saturn-13b-v1 -> nebula-7b-quant -> titan-1-legacy.
nikhil: Add thresholds we care about: 99th latency increase > 25% or error-rate increase > 0.8% triggers automatic rollback. Also watch any new tokenization mismatches.
elaine: Agree. Documenting rollback command and runbook in the release notes. Quick config snippet for the priority map we pushed to the catalog:
```
priority_map:
  - model: saturn-13b-v1
    priority: 10
  - model: nebula-7b-quant
    priority: 20
  - model: titan-1-legacy
    priority: 30
fallback_ttl_seconds: 300
canary_steps: [5,25,100]
```
deploy-bot: [deploy] canary started for catalog:saturn-13b-v1 at 5% across us-west-2/us-east-1 shards. canary_id=cb-2790123456-a
deploy-bot: metrics-stream: https://console.redwood/s/reports/canary/cb-2790123456-a
sarah: SRE here — watching latency and OOM logs. I'll call if 95th or 99th shows a jump. Please ensure tracing hooks are enabled.
maya: Release notes draft: "saturn-13b-v1: improved context handling, better token economy vs nebula; quant-friendly 4-bit path; recommended for low-latency chat workloads." Adding to changelog now.
josh: One ops ask — set fallback TTL to 5 minutes so callers see fast failover, but don't thrash. matches snippet above.
nikhil: Rollback command for quick manual revert if autoscale fails:
```
# pin catalog back to last-stable
redwood catalog pin --model nebula-7b-quant --reason "rollback saturn canary" --duration 1h
```
elaine: Good. Timeline: will observe first 45 minutes, decision call at +60 if anything odd. If all good, we'll finish ramp to 100% at 04:00 UTC. :rocket:
sarah: Acknowledged. I'll post a status update to #incidents if I trigger rollback.
maya: tagging product release notes and docs. I'll merge the changelog PR after canary passes.
deploy-bot: [deploy] canary progress: 5% -> healthy -> waiting 15m
josh: thanks team, please react with :thumbsup: when you see this plan in your dashboards
